queryProtocol.maximum: positive MWI; previous < peak >= next; peak <= pre-step opening half-threshold
queryProtocol.alignment: earliest absolute bandpass maximum in trailing MWI window
queryProtocol.timing: first available sample after confirmation and complete aligned +/-80ms vector; before current emission learning
queryProtocol.scope: all signal-derived below-opening maxima after calibration, including refractory/candidate neighborhoods
queryProtocol.scoring: posthoc +/-150ms; unique baseline misses; mature proposals greedy one-to-one to baseline misses

alignmentProtocol.samples: sign(ms)*round(|ms|*fs/1000); positive = later center; no padding, no future, original query instant
alignmentProtocol.selection: highest signed similarity among available shifts with live templates; tie smaller |ms| then earlier; fallback shift 0
alignmentProtocol.primary: shape-only: original estimated timestamp and scoring labels fixed
alignmentProtocol.secondary: shifted-center timestamp t + selectedSamples/fs, separate denominators
